incidents-bot: INCIDENT alert · elevated 5xx rate on inference-gateway (region: us-west1). Pager triggered for oncall. Link: https://redwood.inc/incident/3622223333 :rotating_light:
jamie: I got the pager, joining triage. starting with quick impact check.
maggie: seeing customer error dashboards spike to ~18% 5xx across /v1/generate. A few customers reporting timeouts.
pranav: throwing logs here from gateway: ```[2026-03-15T21:10:01Z] GET /v1/generate 502 upstream error: connection reset
[2026-03-15T21:10:02Z] GET /v1/generate 504 timeout waiting for runner
[2026-03-15T21:10:03Z] model-runner-42: segfault (core dumped)```.
runtime-ted: runtime logs show repeated SIGSEGV in model-runner on host infer-node-7, memory growth before crash. Also see `std::bad_alloc` in some shards.
sre-lee: hypothesis: model worker OOM/segfault under certain long-context traffic leading to request queueing -> gateway timeouts.
jamie: running targeted query to identify affected model versions. @runtime-ted can you confirm which model-shard pinned to infer-node-7?
runtime-ted: infer-node-7 hosts model v2.1.3 quant-8, and a fallback v1.9 older container. v2.1.3 had recent config change to kv_cache_enabled=true.
maggie: customer-ops, any high-priority customers impacted?
customer-ops: yes — acct: acme-inc reported 30% failure rate on their nightly batch, elevated latency impacting SLA. I've opened customer ticket INC-6821 and informed AE.
pranav: adding runtime stacktrace snippet: ```#0 0x7f9f4a12 in llvm::somekernel()
#1 0x7f9f4b34 in kv_cache::put() at kv_cache.cc:412
#2 0x55aa9f0 main_loop at runner.cc:210```
pranav: also saw high RSS before crash: 38GB on an A100-80GB instance, then spike to 82GB and OOM killer invoked.
sre-lee: immediate mitigation suggestions: 1) disable kv_cache for v2.1.3 traffic 2) scale up runner pool with smaller batch sizes 3) route critical customers to v1.9 fallback.
jamie: executing mitigation 1 now: applying temporary feature-flag to disable kv_cache for v2.1.3 across us-west1. Command: `rbctl rollout set-config v2.1.3 kv_cache_enabled=false --region us-west1 --reason "mitigate OOM/segfault"`
runtime-ted: ack, also reducing default batch_size from 8 -> 2 for v2.1.3 containers: `kubectl -n inference set env deploy/model-runner BATCH_SIZE=2`
pranav: starting traffic reroute for prioritized customers: ```route-rule add /acme-inc -> model:v1.9 priority:high```
maggie: enabling extra alerting for 5xx > 5% for next 2 hours and paging if any regresses.
incidents-bot: NOTE: oncall handoff scheduled in 50m — current oncall jamie -> next oncall maggie.
jamie: brief status: mitigations applied (kv_cache disabled, batch_size reduced, reroute active). gateway 5xx down from 18% -> 6% in last 6m. still seeing isolated segfaults on infer-node-9.
sre-lee: plan next steps: 1) cordon & drain infer-node-7/9, capture core dumps and full heap profiles 2) attach gdb + ask runtime team to run reproducer in staging with long-context prompts 3) consider rollback of v2.1.3 to v2.1.2 if crashes persist.
runtime-ted: grabbing core dumps now: `scp infer-node-7:/var/crash/core.runner.* /tmp/` then uploading to debug bucket.
customer-ops: continuing comms to acme-inc, noting mitigations and ETA 2h for deeper fix.
jamie: handing off to maggie for night shift. maggie — summary: mitigations holding, partial customer routing to fallback, core dumps captured, next steps above. please follow up with postmortem request.
maggie: on it. pinging eng-runtime oncall for deep debug: @runtime-ted @pranav please keep me updated. I'll take the active pager.
pranav: will triage stack traces & run reproducer. created debug run: https://ci.redwood/debug/3622223333/run-7
incidents-bot: INCIDENT status -> mitigated (partial) · severity reduced to S2. Next update expected by 3622227600.
maggie: closing handoff note: if 5xx spikes above 8% again, page SRE and runtime leads. logging timeline in incident doc: https://redwood.inc/incident/3622223333/doc
